description: This file defines interfaces, constants, and types related to gRPC credentials, including transport and per-RPC credentials, security levels, and security info handling. It provides the core credential abstractions used for authentication and security in gRPC connections.

classes.name: CommonAuthInfo
classes.description: Contains authenticated information common to AuthInfo implementations, including security level.

classes.name: ProtocolInfo
classes.description: Provides static information regarding transport credentials, such as protocol version, security protocol, and server name.

classes.name: RequestInfo
classes.description: Contains request data attached to context for GetRequestMetadata calls, including method and AuthInfo.

classes.name: ClientHandshakeInfo
classes.description: Holds data passed to ClientHandshake, including attributes for the address.

methods.name: GetCommonAuthInfo
methods.description: Returns the CommonAuthInfo associated with an AuthInfo.

methods.name: OverrideServerName
methods.description: Overrides the server name used for hostname verification, SNI, and :authority header.

methods.name: RequestInfoFromContext
methods.description: Extracts RequestInfo from context if it exists.

methods.name: NewContextWithRequestInfo
methods.description: Creates a new context with attached RequestInfo.

methods.name: CheckSecurityLevel
methods.description: Checks if a connection's security level meets or exceeds a specified level.
